people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

people.name: Laban
people.line: Brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel

people.name: Paddan
people.line: The homeland of the patriarchs in Mesopotamia

people.name: Rebekah
people.line: Wife of Isaac; mother of Jacob and Esau

translations.web: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan Aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian, to be his wife.
translations.bsb: and Isaac was forty years old when he married Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Aramean from Paddan-aram and the sister of Laban the Aramean.
translations.kjv: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padanaram, the sister to Laban the Syrian.
translations.asv: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan-aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian, to be his wife.
